text:
maria: Opened a docs PR for streaming + pagination snippets (py/ts/go). Need quick sanity checks on retry logic and resume token usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432

alex: On it. Which files changed?

maria: docs/snippets/streaming_py.md, streaming_ts.md, streaming_go.md. Py adds async generator; TS adds readable stream + async iterator; Go adds StreamClient with channels. We also replaced the old 'cursor' header with 'resume_token' in responses.

kevin: Paste the py snippet? I can run locally.

maria: python snippet: from redwood import Client, RetryableError
import asyncio
client = Client()
async def stream_with_retries(prompt):
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            async for chunk in client.stream(prompt, max_retries=0):
                yield chunk
            break
        except RetryableError:
            await asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            continue

sophia: Suggestion: don't silently swallow RetryableError. Use our retry helper or tenacity and show handling of asyncio.CancelledError. Also call out resume_token usage.

maria: Will replace the naive loop with the retry util and add cancellation + resume note.

alex: For TS: show both ReadableStream and for-await-of iterator; include helper to map old cursor header to resume_token for migration doc. I'll draft.

kevin: Go snippet needs context cancellation and to surface StreamResponse.ResumeToken instead of Cursor. I'll open a quick PR to the branch.

dev-docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed, snippets/test failed on streaming_ts.md ": missing await on stream.read()" (line ~48)

maria: Fixing the TS await now.

sophia: I'll review TS + Go in an hour and check the migration blurb we added.

maria: Can someone approve before EOD? Plan to backport to v0.12.x and add migration guide sentence: "If you relied on cursor header, switch to resume_token in response metadata and use client.resume(resume_token) to continue."

alex: Added a small unit test for TS that mocks a 502 and asserts backoff. Pushed.

maria: Follow-ups: 1) swap py loop for retry util + cancellation example, 2) fix TS await + add iterator/readable examples + test, 3) go: add ctx cancel handling + resume_token example, 4) migration guide blurb. Updating PR and pinging reviewers.

dev-docs-bot: PR update detected, snippets/test rerun queued.

maria: Thanks all, ping me if you see anything else after the patch.
